pages.text: Materialism rewires many recipes so that everything flows through the $(thing)TerraFirmaCraft$(0) material chain. Vanilla shortcuts — crafting-table tools, iron blocks, gold from nuggets — are gone; you build up from ores, the anvil, and machines instead.$(br2)This category records the notable changes and the items that have been $(thing)hidden or removed$(0) so they no longer clutter the recipe book.

$(bold)Rule of thumb:$(0) if a recipe in JEI shows TFC ingredients (sheets, rods, nails, gears) it is the intended one. Vanilla ingredients that still appear are usually there because TFC provides no equivalent yet.$(br2)The following entries walk through the biggest reworks, mod by mod.
